Español: Book 2013
English: Image from the "book" of Argentine actor Pablo Scorcelli. This is a "head shot", provided by actors when petitioning for acting parts. Their "book" is the set of images provided to the potential employer. This is a particularly good one at the Commons, as almost all professional head shots are under copyright with the actor. This one was released by the actor himself.
author: Pablo Scorcelli
